$comment: spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r1 task 050 (2026-07-22) — list-tasks Action SEED (systemPrompt home). ACTION-ONLY, no playbook: per ADR-039 a capability is an Action row + Binding row. This is the mirror-first author surface for the sprk_analysisaction row (sprk_actioncode=list-tasks). The Binding that routes to it is in sprk_playbookconsumer-rows.json and DECLARES the core `surface_launch` disposition (BindingDisposition.SurfaceLaunch = 100000007) — the agent selects list-tasks by its tooldescription, dispatch emits a surface_launch SSE with consumerType=list-tasks, and the SpaarkeAi client opens the 'My Tasks' workspace grid tab (ConversationPane.handleSurfaceLaunch). Live rows on spaarkedev1: action 57651aad-8e85-f111-8075-7c1e5268570d, binding 5b1870b9-8e85-f111-8075-7c1e5268570d. Owner hygiene: actionCode carries NO version suffix (list-tasks).
$comment-purpose: This Action DRAFTS NOTHING and CREATES NOTHING. It exists so the agent has a grounded, tool-described capability to select when the user asks to SEE their tasks; the dispatch's only load-bearing effect is the surface_launch that opens the grid. The LLM emits a one-line acknowledgement only — the grid tab shows the real records (sprk_event, Task subtype, statecode=0, ownerid eq-userid, queried client-side by the DataGrid framework). allowstools=false structurally prevents any write/tool call.
name: List Tasks
description: Open the user's task list (their open, assigned Event-Tasks) in a workspace grid tab. Drafts nothing and creates nothing; the tab shows the live records.
$comment-actionType: ExecutorType.AiAnalysis = 0 — handled by the existing prompt-driven executor (ActionRunner + PromptSchemaRenderer). No new executor (ADR-039 reuse).
$comment-temperature: Low — the output is a fixed one-line acknowledgement; no creative latitude is wanted.
systemPrompt: ROLE: The user asked to SEE or list THEIR tasks. This capability OPENS the user's task list (their open, assigned Event-Tasks) in a workspace tab — you do NOT fetch, count, or enumerate the tasks yourself, and you have NO task data. Emit a JSON object matching the output schema EXACTLY (additionalProperties is false): set `acknowledgement` to a brief one-line confirmation that their tasks are opening (for example 'Opening your open tasks.'). Do NOT fabricate task names, counts, due dates, or any task details — you do not have them; the tab shows the real list.

acknowledgement.description: A brief one-line confirmation that the user's task list is opening. Never contains fabricated task details.
